jobs.title: Senior Director, Growth Marketing SVOD
jobs.description:
TELLING CAPTIVATING STORIES TO AUDIENCES EVERYWHERE
  
**Blue Ant Media (TSX:** BAMI) is an international streamer, production studio, advertising sales and rights\-management business. The company operates a diverse portfolio of free streaming and pay TV channels internationally, including Love Nature, Cottage Life, Smithsonian Channel Canada, BBC Earth Canada, HauntTV, Homeful, and Love Pets, as well as the subscription streaming service MagellanTV. Its studio business produces and distributes a wide range of premium content across key genres for streaming and broadcast platforms worldwide. Blue Ant Media is headquartered in Toronto, with a presence in Los Angeles, New York, Miami, Singapore, London, Washington, Sydney, Halifax, and Ottawa. blueantmedia.com⼁Instagram⼁LinkedIn
  
Our employees are passionate experts in all of our business areas. They are fanatical about creating outstanding content and experiences, and about delivering them on new and evolving platforms. We actively seek new employees who embody our core values. We want them to think big, act with purpose, celebrate creativity, do the right thing, respect one another, and succeed together. We attract creative talents who are optimistic about the evolving future of content and who take pride in recognizing opportunities where others see challenges. At Blue Ant Media, we give them the flexibility to think like entrepreneurs, take ownership of their projects, take risks, and embrace innovation in a rapidly evolving media landscape. Our team members excel at collaborating with internal and external partners by building trusting, respectful working relationships.
  
  

Senior Director, Growth Marketing, SVOD
  
Blue Ant Media is looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded and performance\-driven Senior Marketing Director to lead performance marketing across the business.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a growth\-oriented marketing leader to help accelerate our SVOD growth, primarily in the US, while supporting expansion into new international markets and lines of business.
  
The Senior Director, Growth Marketing will own the end\-to\-end marketing function, with a mandate to drive subscriber acquisition, define and optimize marketing investment, improve customer conversion and maximize subscriber lifetime value. This role will oversee the full subscriber marketing funnel, from awareness and acquisition through conversion, engagement, retention and winback.
  
**We are looking for a true performance marketing expert:** someone who is exceptionally analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and passionate about translating insights into measurable business results. They will bring a test\-and\-learn mindset, a deep understanding of digital acquisition and subscription economics, and the ability to balance short\-term performance with sustainable long\-term growth.
  
While performance marketing is at the heart of this role, experience developing brands and building integrated marketing strategies will be a valuable asset.
  
This new role will report to the SVP, Marketing, Consumer Brands and is a hybrid position requiring in\-office attendance at our head office in Toronto for a minimum of three (3\) days per week.
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000 per year, with final compensation determined by experience and qualifications.
  
Core Responsibilities \& Duties
  
Growth and Performance Marketing
  
* Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy and growth plan, with subscriber growth and revenue as primary objectives.
* Own the subscriber acquisition strategy, driving efficient and scalable growth through paid media, digital channels and other acquisition opportunities.
* Establish and manage key performance metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), subscriber lifetime value (LTV), retention and churn.
* Drive continuous optimization of marketing investment, ensuring budgets are allocated to the channels, audiences and campaigns delivering the strongest business results.
* Identify opportunities to improve the full acquisition funnel, from initial engagement through trial, subscription conversion and ongoing customer value.
* Lead a rigorous test\-and\-learn approach across creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages, offers, channels and campaign strategies.
* Use data, analytics and customer insights to identify growth opportunities, understand performance drivers and inform strategic decisions.


Customer Journey, Engagement and Retention
  
* Oversee the customer lifecycle marketing strategy, ensuring a cohesive and effective journey from prospect to subscriber to loyal customer.
* Drive the development and optimization of CRM initiatives, including email and push notifications, to improve conversion, engagement, retention and reactivation.
* Leverage customer segmentation, behavioural insights and performance data to deliver relevant, personalized communications.
* Identify opportunities to reduce subscriber churn, increase engagement and maximize customer lifetime value.
* Ensure acquisition and lifecycle marketing strategies work together to deliver sustainable subscriber growth.


Marketing Strategy and Brand Development
  
* Develop a cohesive marketing strategy that supports positioning, audience growth and commercial objectives.
* Ensure brand strategy, creative development and campaign messaging are informed by audience insights and performance data.
* Partner with internal programming, creative, product and commercial teams to develop compelling campaigns that drive awareness, consideration and subscription.
* Identify opportunities to build brand awareness and strengthen our competitive position in the US streaming market.
* Support the development and execution of marketing strategies for new international markets, adapting channel mix, audience targeting and messaging to local market dynamic

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Security Operations)
jobs.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As Director of Product Management for Security Operations and Digital Forensics, you will own the vision, strategy, execution, and business outcomes for both Lines of Business within the OpenText Portfolio Business Unit. You will lead a team of Product Managers and partner across Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, AI leadership, Architecture, and executive leadership to drive revenue growth, retention, cloud adoption, market expansion, and profitability.
  
You will shape investment priorities across on\-premises, private and sovereign cloud, and OpenText\-hosted private\-cloud SaaS offerings. By connecting customer needs and market opportunities in SOC modernization, threat detection and response, cyber resilience, digital investigations, compliance, and examiner productivity, you will strengthen OpenText's position as a trusted provider of Security Operations and Digital Forensics solutions.
  
  

What the Role Offers
  
  

* Ownership of the vision, strategy, investment priorities, and business performance for the Security Operations and Digital Forensics Lines of Business.
* The opportunity to develop and maintain 8\-quarter product roadmaps and lead Product Strategy Reviews covering performance, investments, competitive positioning, and future opportunities.
* Accountability for portfolio KPIs and measurable outcomes across growth, retention, cloud transformation, market position, margin improvement, and profitability.
* Decision authority for product lifecycle governance, roadmap prioritization, feature investments, pricing, packaging, partner decisions, release readiness, compliance, security, certifications, localization, and communications.
* The ability to drive platform modernization through cloud\-aligned architectures, Kubernetes, SaaS transformation, and AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities that improve SOC analyst and examiner productivity.
* Leadership of competitive strategy across SIEM, Security Analytics, SOAR, XDR, Threat Intelligence, DFIR, and adjacent markets, including positioning, pricing, packaging, and commercialization.
* A central role in go\-to\-market execution with Product Marketing, including messaging, analyst engagement, sales enablement, launch readiness, customer advisory boards, executive engagements, partner discussions, and industry forums.
* The opportunity to lead Buy, Build, or Partner decisions and identify portfolio convergence and strategic integration opportunities across OpenText.
* Leadership and development of a high\-performing team of Product Managers and senior product professionals, with accountability for hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.
* A highly visible role requiring strategic agility, critical analysis, innovation, resilience, and the ability to influence senior leaders, customers, analysts, and partners in a complex global environment.


What You Need to Succeed
  
  

* 10\+ years of progressive Product Management experience in enterprise software, cybersecurity, digital investigations, or related markets, including significant leadership of Product Managers and complex portfolios.
* Minimum 5 years of managerial leadership experience with demonstrated success developing high\-performing teams and future product leaders.
* Deep expertise in Security Operations, SIEM, Security Analytics, Threat Detection and Response, SOC workflows, SOAR, log analytics, and threat intelligence.
* Strong understanding of Digital Forensics, DFIR, investigative workflows, forensic acquisition and analysis, evidence management, and chain of custody.
* Proven track record owning portfolio vision and strategy while delivering measurable outcomes in revenue growth, retention, cloud adoption, and profitability.
* Experience leading SaaS transformation, cloud modernization, containerized platforms, and enterprise\-scale portfolios.
* Demonstrated success influencing executive stakeholders and driving alignment across global cross\-functional organizations.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to balance strategic investments, customer commitments, engineering priorities, and commercial objectives, and translate technical concepts into compelling business strategies.
* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent experience. An advanced degree and relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCFE, GCFA, EnCE, GREM, or equivalent are desirable.


**One Last Thing:**  

OpenText is more than a corporation—it’s a global community built on trust, character, and purpose. Here, we act ethically, care deeply about people, and always put our clients first. We help teams succeed through collaboration, tackle challenges with resilience, and innovate with intention.
  
Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and teamwork. At OpenText, we don’t just have a culture—we live our values. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that empowers you to make a meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Investment Director
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Nesbridge is a bespoke capital advisory services firm with over 28 years of experience. We specialize in Structured Financing large capital\-intensive businesses in North America gain access to financial solutions beyond the conventional offerings of traditional banks or brokers.

We are seeking a dynamic **Investment Director** to lead our capital raising initiatives in commercial real estate located in Canada \& USA.

This is a commissioned fees per transaction based role responsible for capital raising and deal origination in building new clients in addition to fostering existing clients relationships.

Team members join a niche advisory industry that values expertise, rigor, and long‑term client relationships.

**YOU HAVE:**

* Capital Raising, Deal Origination and Business Development experience
* Dynamic personality with good listening, communication abilities, including negotiation skills
* Demonstrated integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to deliver bespoke capital strategies and ensure that client engagements are well\-structured, compliant, and aligned with market conditions
* Relevant experience in capital markets, private equity, commercial real estate, or financial advisory
* Strategic thinker with solid problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities

**MUST HAVE:**

* Previous experience capital raising for commercial real estate transactions
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, business administration, economics, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a plus

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience working in investment banking, brokerage, advisory firms, or similar fields

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Profit sharing

Application question(s):

* Not a salaried position, are you comfortable with results based commissioned fees?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greater Toronto Area, ON

jobs.title: Vice President Finance & CFO
jobs.description:
**About GrandBridge Corporation** **Who We Are:**  

GrandBridge Corporation is an investment holding company dedicated to driving growth and innovation through our fully owned subsidiaries, GrandBridge Energy Inc., and GrandBridge Group Inc.  

GrandBridge Energy Inc. is a leading provider of innovative energy solutions, committed to delivering reliable and sustainable energy to our customers. GrandBridge Group Inc. offers a wide range of energy services through its divisions: Netoptiks, which provides cutting\-edge telecommunications solutions, and Enersure, which ensures our customers' homes are comfortable and energy\-efficient with home comfort rentals.  

Our team of dedicated professionals are committed to helping our communities navigate the transition towards a dynamic and evolving energy landscape. The principles and beliefs that guide our operations are deeply rooted in our values. **Join us in our mission to shape the future of energy.** **What We Offer*** Employer Paid Benefits Package
* OMERS Pension Plan
* Training and Educational Reimbursement Programs
* Professional Development \& Career Opportunities
* Wellness Resources \& Healthy Lifestyle Incentives
* Employee and Family Assistance Program
* Opportunities for Community Involvement
 **About The Role:**


GrandBridge Corporation is seeking an accomplished financial executive to fill the recently vacated position of Vice President, Finance \& Chief Financial Officer (CFO). As a key member of the Executive Leadership team, reporting directly to the President \& CEO, you will provide strategic leadership and executive oversight for finance, accounting, business and financial planning, treasury, tax, enterprise risk management, investor relations and procurement, while serving as a trusted advisor to the President \& CEO, Board of Directors, and Executive Leadership team.

  

You will play a critical role in shaping the Corporation’s financial strategy, long\-term sustainability, and overall business performance. As the Corporation’s senior financial executive, you will lead the development and execution of financial strategies that support growth across both regulated and competitive businesses, while ensuring sound governance, prudent risk management, disciplined capital allocation, and strong financial stewardship.

  

You will play a significant role in evaluating and executing mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships and other investment opportunities, including assessing financial risks, investment returns and long\-term value creation. You will also lead capital financing strategies, evaluate funding alternatives and optimize capital allocation to support the Corporation's strategic priorities and long\-term financial sustainability.

  

We are seeking an accomplished and forward\-thinking leader with significant experience in corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, capital financing and long\-term financial planning, ideally gained within the energy or utility sector. The successful candidate will bring the strategic insight, financial acumen and executive presence required to navigate complex business decisions and support the Corporation through a period of continued growth and transformation.

  

You will be a collaborative and trusted partner who builds strong relationships, influences complex decisions and leads with integrity, accountability and a commitment to excellence. You will foster a high\-performing, engaged team while advancing a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and exceptional service to customers, stakeholders and the communities we serve.

 **What You Will Do:**

**Strategic Leadership \& Business Performance**:

* Partner with the President \& CEO, Corporate Development and Executive Leadership team to shape and execute our growth strategy across regulated and competitive businesses.
* Provide strategic advice on enterprise strategy, capital deployment, growth, risk and financial implications of major decisions.
* Lead financial strategies that support sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long\-term value creation.
* Align financial plans, resources, funding plans, and performance measures with corporate priorities.
* Develop decision frameworks, scenarios, and performance insights that improve the quality and speed of Executive and Board decisions.
* Champion accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and data\-driven decision\-making.


**Growth, M\&A, and Competitive Business Development**

* Lead the financial evaluation of acquisitions, mergers, partnerships, joint ventures, new markets and business opportunities.
* Develop transaction and financing structures that balance strategic value, financial returns, tax, regulatory requirements, and overall capital capacity.
* Serve as a strategic partner by strengthening business models, pricing, investment governance, performance measures and scalable financial capabilities that support profitable growth.
* Co\-lead transaction integration and post\-investment oversight, including financial systems, controls, cost allocation, synergy tracking and benefits realization, ensuring that approved investments deliver sustainable enterprise value.

* Provide executive leadership for all finance, accounting and financial planning functions.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
Department IT
Location Montreal
At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a growing company, a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment?


We are looking for a **Head of Data \& Business Intelligence** to join our Data \& Business Intelligence team. This position reports to the **Director of Software Development Unit – Internal Tools.**


As Head of Data \& Business Intelligence, you will drive the technical data vision and strategy for the entire organization. A deeply technical leader, you will have an in\-depth command of the systems, architecture, and automations that power our data. Your role will be to keep growing the strategic value of our data, maintaining alignment between our technological capabilities and business objectives. You will act as a key leader in the continued evolution of our culture and practices, connecting technical teams and leadership.


### **Your day\-to\-day**


* **Define the strategic vision:** Develop and drive the roadmap for data architecture, technology, and warehousing
* **Champion data culture:** Promote the importance of data quality, standardize definitions, and implement clear processes to shift the organization toward a predictive approach
* **Guide and unify teams:** Lead, mentor, and ensure effective collaboration between local and remote data teams, prioritizing high\-impact business initiatives
* **Ensure technical excellence:** Oversee the design of a reliable and high\-performing data ecosystem, while directly contributing (approximately 30%) to the design of systems, architectures, and automations to stay connected to ground\-level realities
* **Agentic leadership:** Guide a team already working with agentic development as it migrates our processes onto our in\-house agentic platform, putting in place what makes those automations trustworthy: validation, observability, guardrails, and governance
### **Your qualifications**


* Over 10 years of experience in data, business intelligence, and analytics, including team management
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business objectives into a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap
* Strong leadership experience, with a talent for mentoring, change management, and aligning multidisciplinary teams, including data science and data engineering
* Proficiency in data architecture concepts (Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, ETL/ELT, streaming, Pub/Sub) and Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* In\-depth command of systems and architecture concepts, with the ability to design end\-to\-end solutions and assess their robustness
* Mastery of agentic development and automated software production pipelines (agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, guardrails), and a proven ability to lead a team working this way
* Ability to build well\-founded trust in automated systems: measuring their reliability, understanding their limits, and keeping human judgment where it matters
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
* Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken, with strong spoken fluency in both languages
### **Nice\-to\-haves**


* Hands\-on experience managing the merger of technology stacks and teams
* Knowledge of data ecosystems and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Apache Beam, DBT, Google Cloud Dataflow, Tableau, etc.)
* Experience with the advertising data industry (SSAI, SSP, DSP)
* Ability to design business intelligence strategies tailored to different business models (e.g., subscription services, advertising)
* Knowledge of various programming and database languages (Python, Java, Rust, SQL, etc.)
### **The Team You Will Join**


* A technical Data \& Business Intelligence team of 8 people, including a technical lead and a project manager in Montreal
* Collaboration with a remote data science team \& a remote data engineering team
* Collaborative work with leaders across the entire company
### **Life at Stingray**


* A cool office in Montreal with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays
* Stingray café with breakfasts, lunches and snacks offered every day
* A subsidy for your OPUS card to make your commutes easier
* Shares purchase plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
* Full access to the Dialogue virtual healthcare platform
* Free fitness classes offered weekly
* Access to private consultations on nutrition and wellness
* Free language classes, training and access to the latest AI technologies and platforms to boost your productivity and creativity
* Summer hours
* Milestones celebrated with our loyalty program
* 5@7 and vibrant social events
* And much more!
We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.


Montreal\-based Stingray Group is a leading music, media and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. Our offices are located in the **Old Port of Montreal** just minutes from the Lachine Canal bike path, a prime location for picnics or a jog at lunch time.


Stingray supports the principles of Employment Equity and is committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve and in which we operate. Women, Aboriginal peoples, persons with disabilities and visible minorities are encouraged to apply and to self\-identify so we can work towards full representation of those groups within our company.


Not the job for you? Go to jobs.stingray.com to consult other available positions and learn more about Stingray, we’re always on the lookout for new talent.
